info.name: Flipturn Access IDs Maintenance Windows API

params.name: afterTimestamp
params.description: ISO 8601: windows whose end time is after this timestamp.

params.name: beforeTimestamp
params.description: ISO 8601: windows whose start time is before this timestamp.

params.name: siteIds
params.description: Filter to chargers at specific site IDs.

params.name: organizationIds
params.description: Filter to specific organization IDs (parent-org keys only).

params.name: nextPageCursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response's pagination.nextPageCursor to fetch the next page. Keep all other parameters identical.

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of maintenance windows across chargers (up to 50 per page). Parent-org keys return windows for all child organizations.
